items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... It wasn't Darcy, were you? [INTERVIEWEE] No, it wasn't Darcy.

ctx.x: Well no, maybe it was your birthday, it was one of your birthday parties, that's what it was. It was your birthday party about four years ago, and it was an old bass player, I forget what his name was, and a couple of people asked him to play, and I don't know who had been playing the bass, and then sing said, oh, and he didn't want to play, and sing said I'm going to play. And I said I didn't know you could play the bass thing. And sing said, sure, I can play the bass and I can play the banjo too. But then after…

This was somebody who, but he wouldn't play until sing, sing got up and played a little bit on the bass, and then he came up and he said, come here, I'm going to show you how to do it, young fella. And then sing went over and took the banjo, and played the banjo. And I didn't have the camera that day.
